title: Elderpup's QOL: Blocks
description: Elderpup's Quality Of Life mod enhances Minecraft with new amethyst, magma, and hay bale blocks, offering both aesthetic and functional improvements while preserving the core gameplay experience.
body:
Elderpup's Quality Of Life is a mod designed to enhance your Minecraft experience by adding subtle but impactful features that improve gameplay without changing the core feel of the game. Currently, the mod introduces amethyst blocks, which bring new aesthetic and functional possibilities to your world. Whether you're building intricate structures or exploring new materials, these shiny blocks will add a sparkle to your creativity. Stay tuned for future updates as this mod evolves with more features aimed at improving convenience, design, and overall gameplay enjoyment.

Please Contact Me At Elderpup.wulf2013@gmail.com For questions about Sharing this mod to other platforms.
Thanks. :)
